comment: Read from src/Bytebeat.cpp at commit fb01326, the commit whose plugin.json carries the installed 2.11.1, alongside docs/Cella_Manual.md written for 2.11.0. The manual calls the second menu item Multiline with an on and off state; the code's item is Submit/New Line with the choices Enter/Shift+Enter and Shift+Enter/Enter (Bytebeat.cpp:437). The three CV knobs are attenuators from 0 to 1 rather than attenuverters (Bytebeat.cpp:127 to 129), so a jack cannot be inverted. The clock rate is measured between rises and clamped to between 0.001Hz and 1000Hz (Bytebeat.cpp:163); the FREQ knob then multiplies half that figure by two to the power of the knob, which is why the hover text changes from hertz to a multiplier when a clock is patched. The expression editor is a LedDisplayTextField, not a parameter, so it has no census position and no click on it can reach a help line.
